maps.note: THE ENEMY LANE (FORWARD-MANIFEST-hero §E, now built). 4 m module, run "+X", repeat 4.0, width 3.4: two tyre-and-boot ruts 1.5 m apart in trodden grass, no kerb, ≤200 tris / 1 part, y 0.06. Same grass material as the terrain tile with the wear in vertex colour, so its edges vanish into the field and only the track shows. CLIENT: lay it along every WALKED leg of direct/long/west exactly as other maps lay <map>_path_ground — skip the teleport legs (long 11 & 20, west 11) — instead of the gravel road module. Where the lane runs down the county road it sits over the asphalt a metre narrower than the carriageway. ~160 placements, instanced.

Two FIELD variants of the 20 m tile, same contract as v0–v3 (≤900 tris, relief ≤0.15 m, dead flat 2 m in): v4 rough grazed pasture (clumpy yellow-green sward, stock-worn paths), v5 cut hay stubble in 3 m mower widths along +X with a raked windrow every third pass. CLIENT: assign by REGION, not by the hash — levels.js `fields`: v5 for tiles wholly inside x 80…140 / z −20…60 (the hayfield), v4 for x −140…−20 / z −60…−20 (the pasture); everything else keeps the v0–v3 cycle. Tile-aligned, because a variant is a whole tile.

REPLACEMENTS for the delivered eight — same ids, same centres, same door offsets, same roof deck heights, so no collider or socket moves. What changed: casings are FRAMES (head, jambs, sill) proud of the face instead of a slab centred in the opening (every window read as a blank stucco square, every doorway as a panel); window pane env response cut .55→.18 so panes no longer mirror the sky white; concrete steps at every person door except the three the lane passes within 3.5 m of (barn N, vehickle entry, grnmchn entry — `nosteps`); gutters and corner downspouts; chimneys through the slope (buggy 1, vehickle 2, grnmchn 1, in the shell brick); sliding-door rails over both barn bays; barn pitch 6°→12° (ridge 9.2 m) with two louvred ridge cupolas — the 6° lid read as flat from every angle the game uses; gable ENDS are now wall (stucco on the houses, brick on the barn) in a separate `_gable` part rather than shingle closers. Shell ≤7,000 tris / 14 parts (+_gutters, +steps in _foundation); roof ≤2,000 / 6 parts (+_gable, +_chimney or _cupola). Barn roof collider: the flat 6×6 deck at local (12, −7.5) is unchanged at 6.3; the ridge is now 9.2, so any roof-bounds check that assumed ≤6.5 needs the new height.

What divides 320 m of lawn into a property. fence_wire: 5-strand on a steel T-post, run "+X", repeat 4.0, width 0.1, 1.3 high, ≤120/2, INSTANCED (~180) — posts on the module end so runs share posts. gate_farm: 4 m galvanised tube gate between timber posts, same module length, drops into a run in place of one module; hung shut (an open gate is an opening the sim does not know). hedgerow: 4 m of overgrown field hedge, MASK cards two greens + bare stems, run "+X", repeat 4.0, width 1.8, ≤400/3, instanced (~18). tree_oak_open: open-grown hedgerow oak, 16 m, crown r 7.5, 2 parts, `userData.plan = "round"` (measure clearance from centre less radius — as a box its corners reached r√2), placed ONE AT A TIME (~10), never by the belt lattice. tree_apple: 4.6 m orchard tree, r 2.4, 2 parts, 16 in the orchard. crop_rows: 10×10 m module, 13 ridged soybean rows on 760 mm centres along +X, plants as MASK cards, ≤700/2, instanced, 12 fill the crop field. CLIENT (ToasterLevel.BuildToasterDressing): four enclosures as fence RUNS — pasture (−118,−60)→(−24,−60)→(−24,−28)→(−118,−28), gates at module 4 of the E side and 12 of the N side; orchard (−146,−36)→(−122,−36)→(−122,−60), gate at module 3; crop field (−41,7)→(−9,7)→(−9,49)→(−41,49), gate at module 4 of the S side; hayfield (85,−16)→(85,62)→(146,62)→(146,−16), gates at module 9 of the W side and 7 of the S side. Hedgerow x 82, z −12…58 every 4 m, yaw π/2 ±0.05 alternating; oaks at (86,−10) (82,40) (82,58) (−30,−35) (−48,−52) (−100,−44) (−72,−57) (−20,61) (−75,60) (112,−30) (38,−40); orchard 4×4 on 6 m centres from (−143,−57); crop 3×4 modules from (−35,13) on 10 m. All through the same Clear() rule, plus a new refusal: nothing generated may land inside a building volume (footprint + own radius + 1 m) — the first drop stood two propane tanks and two woodpiles inside walls because nothing checked.

The things a farm has BETWEEN its buildings. grain_bin: corrugated galvanised bin on a concrete pad, stiffener rings every 950 mm, 30° cone, side ladder, unloading auger; 5.5 dia × 5.2 eave (v1 7.3 × 7.0), ≤3,000/3, turned from one profile. fuel_tank: red gravity diesel tank on a rusted steel stand, 2.3×1.0 at 2.6 m, ≤900/3. windmill: Aermotor-pattern pump mill, 10 m four-leg lattice tower, 2.5 m 18-blade wheel, tail vane, ≤5,000/6 — the wheel is ONE part named `toaster_windmill_wheel` and the group declares `userData.spin = { part, axis: [0,0,1], rpm: 14 }`; the client may turn it (setInterval, not rAF — CLAUDE.md viewer rule). stock_tank: 2.4 dia galvanised, water at y 0.5, fill pipe. bale_feeder: 2.4 m tube ring with a bale stood in it. shed_small: 3.6×2.4×2.4 board shed under corrugated lean-to, door ajar on +Z, nest box on +X (hen house / garden shed). garden_plot: 4 raised beds + low wire, 8×7.4. clothesline: 8 m, 3 sagging lines, washing. hay_wagon: 2.4×7.2×2.9, five bales aboard — DRESSING, no rig. reeds: cattail clump, 2 m, ≤200/2, instanced on the pond shelf. CLIENT placements (levels.js `place`, all clearance-checked): bin#1 (−137,50) yaw .4; bin (−137,59.5) 1.1; fuel (−127,38); windmill (−85,−46); stock_tank (−81,−46); feeders (−60,−50) and (−100,−36) .8; shed_small (110,−58) π and (36,52) π; gardens (26,53) and (−134,−30); clotheslines (14,50) and (112,−48) π/2; wagon (100,44) .3; reeds on r 16.2 from the pond centre at angles .35 .95 1.6 3.55 4.25 4.95 5.6 6.05 (none dock-side, none where the lane passes).

10 m treated pole, single 2.2 m crossarm, three insulators (outer ±0.95 at 9.6, pin at 10.2); v1 adds a pole-mounted transformer. ≤600/3. CLIENT: poles every 36 m down the county road and every 40 m down the south road, 5.5 m off the centreline on the right-hand side of travel, every third pole v1; each through Clear() (verge class — kerb test, not the 2 m road margin). Then CONDUCTORS between consecutive poles that were actually placed: three per span from the pole's own attachment points, catenary sag = min(1.8, 0.00065·span² + 0.25) — ~0.9 m on a 36 m span, 16 mm radius, 6 segments per span; design builds them in `buildToasterWires(K, lines)` off the placed-pole list, so a refused pole shortens a span rather than leaving wire over nothing. No wire dips below 8.5 m; §4.10 headroom is never in question.

Two layout changes on the made roads. (1) SHED APRON: 8 m of the drive's gravel across the whole +Z front of the barn, centreline (−122,68.5)→(−90,68.5), width 8, kind `apron` — drawn as two rows of the 4 m gravel module 15 mm under the drive so the two gravels do not fight. Surface lookup: gravel. (2) The road builder lays rows for any `width` wider than its module, and the bend fillet scales in Z to match. The wreck moved off the new apron to (−128,63) yaw 1.2; propane tanks now at (44,47.5), (−146.4,−12), (105,−50); woodpiles (−120,40), (106,−42) — the four old coordinates were inside building footprints.

The level as re-authored in models/levels.js: routes, sockets, stations, spawn, core, teleport legs and vehicle parking UNCHANGED (sim truth in Maps.cs is untouched). Everything above is design; validators at 0 with 84 sockets (Crowded 0 · Perched 0 · Uncovered 0 · Headroom 0 · Off-lane 0 · Stranded 0). Fence/hedge/pole/crop/orchard rows are generated by RULE in levels.js (`fence()`, `poleLine()`) against the same clearance test the client refuses on — port the rules, not a coordinate list. Ratchet: the toaster row of map-validation-baseline.tsv stays at 0; dressing count rises from ~130 to ~560 placements, of which ~420 are in eight instanced sets (wire, hedgerow, crop, apple, reeds, bale, scatter, understory).

vehicles.note: Rear-engined saloon, 2 seats abreast, hull 1.55×1.5×4.1, wheel r 0.29, steer_wheel, eye 1.15. Farm-kept, faded paint, one dented wing.
Utility vehicle, hull 1.5×1.85×2.9, wheel r 0.31, bench seat, roll cage, open bed with strapped tarp, light bar, eye 1.0. Lives in the barn and is driven through its 5×4 door.

Motorised drift trike, hull 0.9×0.9×1.9. Front wheel_0 r 0.25 on a fork that is also the steering node; rear wheel_1/_2 r ~0.13 in plastic drift sleeves. Steers by TWO LEVERS (steer_lever_l/_r pivoting about Y at the fork), not a wheel — which is why it spins on the spot. Eye 0.75, the lowest on the map. Green.
Sport quad, hull 1.16×1.13×1.85, wheel r 0.28, steer_bars, saddle eye 1.05. Fastest thing on the map at 22 m/s.

Two poses through the existing HAND_POSES mechanism, six sets each. wheel: ten-and-two on a 0.38 m rim, origin at the hub, viewmodel frame. bars: grips 0.7 m apart, used by the quad and the trike's levers. Not blocking; wheel first if only one is affordable.
